author: Hoon Kim
title: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator
content: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator. We'll provide character design concepts. You'll create high-quality, commercial-use illustrations with poses and backgrounds. Quality level matching the attached characters. Requirements: - Japanese anime art style (see attached images) - Experience with 2D game character art - Faithful to the original design (hair, outfit, colors) - work needs to match the quality of the attached examples (especially the coloring). To apply: Send your portfolio. Feel free to reach out!

author: Jobs.com
title: HIRING! Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist Fully Remote
content: HIRING! Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist Fully Remote https://work.turing.com/r/BpA6o2F8Jm Role Overview: We are looking for talented Illustrators, Sketchers, Cartoonists, Digital Artists, and Concept Artists who can create high-quality artwork from reference images while introducing creative variations and maintaining the character’s identity. This opportunity is open to interns, freshers, emerging artists, and experienced professionals with strong visual skills and a portfolio that demonstrates creativity, versatility, and attention to detail. What You’ll Do: 1. Create digital character illustrations and sketches using provided reference images. 2. Produce creative variations while maintaining character identity and visual consistency. 3. Apply core fundamentals of composition, color, lighting, perspective, and proportion. 4. Adapt artwork across diverse visual themes based on project requirements. 5. Document creative decisions, style choices, and simple prompt metadata. 6. Deliver polished, high-quality artwork within assigned project timelines.

author: Geek Realm Hub
title: The Pokémon Company is hiring a full-time Pokémon Sleep illustrator
content: The Pokémon Company is hiring a full-time Pokémon Sleep illustrator! Dream job alert for Pokémon artists! The Pokémon Company has opened a full-time illustrator position focused on creating artwork for Pokémon Sleep. The role includes designing Pokémon sleeping poses using vector illustrations, creating in-game assets such as items, dishes, and environments, checking artwork quality, and directing external illustrators. Applicants need at least two years of professional vector illustration experience, proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop, experience matching established character and IP art styles, and a background in the gaming or entertainment industry. The position is based at The Pokémon Company's headquarters in Roppongi, Tokyo, Japan. https://hrmos.co/pages/pokemon/jobs/0000147
